_comment: Hand-maintained SOURCE for the portal documentation index. scripts/gen-docs-catalog.py projects this into site/data/docs.js (do not edit docs.js by hand). Every repo Markdown file MUST be either listed here or matched by an 'exclude' glob; CI (gen-docs-catalog.py --check) fails otherwise, so a newly added doc can never silently miss the portal. Omit 'title'/'desc' to auto-derive them from the file's H1 and first paragraph.
